root: Uni-CLI 1.0.3 adds 23 provider-native operations for Zhihu, X, Lark and Feishu, and Bluesky while preserving each official CLI and its structured response.
The external tool catalog now records official provenance, native surface, and provider scope for local CLI and MCP entry points.
Feishu operations now use the official lark-cli, while Slack content operations use the official Web API instead of the application-development CLI.
The public documentation gains a rebuilt green observatory interface, orbital operation chapters, clearer guides, and a repository-wide human-writing harness.
zh: Uni-CLI 1.0.3 新增 23 个平台原生 operation，覆盖知乎、X、Lark 和飞书，以及 Bluesky，并保留官方 CLI 与结构化响应。
外部工具目录现在记录本地 CLI 与 MCP 入口的官方来源、原生形式和提供方能力范围。
飞书 operation 已迁到官方 lark-cli，Slack 内容 operation 则调用官方 Web API。
公共文档完成绿色天文台界面与轨道 operation 章节重构，同时补齐关键指南并接入统一的 human-writing harness。
